style.name: 下町暖帘
style.prefix: Cinematic semi-realistic anime visual-novel illustration, warm nostalgic palette of caramel gold and indigo-dyed noren blue, early-summer 2009 Tokyo Nihonbashi Ningyocho, traditional storefronts with wooden lattices and fabric shop curtains, golden afternoon light, lived-in everyday shitamachi warmth, soft film grain.
style.suffix: High detail, atmospheric, warm humane mood, key-visual quality, no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
globalConstraints: 人物只用背影、远景剪影、无可辨认正脸的侧写或局部手部；加贺不出正脸
冷灰色调只用于案发公寓、警署与程序性案情场景
峯子除真结局守望蒙太奇外只以背影、侧影或局部呈现
遗体、伤口与行凶过程不出画面；纸绳只作中性静物且不得形成绳套
未成年人不与案件物证同框，不进入压迫式问询画面
画面内不出现可读文字、品牌标识、水印或超出 2009 年代的设备
style.negative: gore, violence in progress, visible corpse, wound, noose, identifiable face, celebrity likeness, readable text, logo, watermark, modern smartphone, cyberpunk neon, glossy 3D render

items.prompt: 2009 early-summer dusk on Ningyocho old shopping street; indigo noren and wooden storefronts; nearest curtain gently lifted by one adult hand; distant adult back silhouettes; caramel shop light meets indigo dusk; clean title-overlay space; no text or faces.
Golden-afternoon Ningyocho old shopping street with indigo noren, wooden lattices and distant adult back silhouettes; lively humane neighborhood warmth.
Traditional rice-cracker shop storefront on Amazake Yokocho; indigo noren, wooden lattice, trays of glazed senbei; adult shopkeeper's cropped hands wrapping a purchase.
Empty small translator's apartment after investigators have left; cool gray procedural stillness, intact room, tea and books; no body, blood or sensational evidence.
Traditional kappo restaurant tatami room after lunch; lacquer table, empty cushions, shoji light and covered ningyo-yaki tray; no people or crime imagery.
Long narrow family ceramics shop; shelves of bowls, warm wood counter, tissue wrapping and household scissors as neutral still life.
Old neighborhood clock shop interior; walls of analog clocks, glass repair counter, brass tools and empty dog lead by the door; warm late-afternoon light.
Hamacho Park between showers; fresh green leaves, sunlit path and elderly adult walking a small dog from behind at respectful distance.
Cozy neighborhood patisserie; cake display, caramel afternoon light, adult woman customer as back silhouette and adult clerk in distant side silhouette.
Warm apartment study shared by adult translators; two desks, reference books and wrapped couple chopsticks on a blank envelope; empty room.
Cleaning-company president's modest office; warm desk, unreadable ledgers, face-down family photo and adult secretary as distant back silhouette.
Traditional folk-craft shop packed with wooden toys, paper goods and spinning tops; one top displayed without pull-string; no children or people.
Suitengu shrine precinct in clear early-summer morning; charm stall with unreadable objects; two adult figures far apart from behind; gentle reconciliation mood.
Top-down restaurant table; open ningyo-yaki box, one pastry split to show a tiny dab of mustard and exactly three adult hands; harmless domestic prank, no distress or victim.
Two adult women reconcile across ceramics-shop counter; hands only, passing wrapped household scissors; faces absent.
Elderly adult man and adult Mineko separately choosing safe-childbirth charms at Suitengu; side/back silhouettes only, Mineko's face hidden; soft memory haze.
Through patisserie glass, adult Mineko outside as back silhouette quietly watches an adult clerk in distant side silhouette; tender cake reflections; face hidden.
Wrapped couple chopsticks gently offered by an adult detective's cropped hand to an adult woman's cropped hands across warm study table; no faces.
Adult father and adult daughter recognize one another in office; restrained side/back silhouettes, faces obscured, old blank photo frame by their hands.
Forensic-neutral still life of wooden spinning top beside separate coil of clean paper pull-string; gloved adult hands at edge; never shaped as a noose.
Two adult fathers sit across a quiet interview table in side/back silhouette, faces hidden; humane confession, no cuffs, struggle or intimidation; cool gray with warm side light.
Adult detective Kaga on Nihonbashi at dusk carrying a ningyo-yaki box, shown only from behind; warm city lights and indigo evening.

True-ending memory montage; the only image allowing adult Mineko's gentle frontal smile, surrounded by fragments of hands offering scissors, chopsticks, cake and shrine charm; adult son from behind; no death imagery.
